# VÉRANE workspace

- Next.js App Router with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
- Use `npm.cmd` on Windows if PowerShell blocks the `npm` shim.
- Keep product display data behind `src/lib/products.ts` or Prisma data access.
- Keep secrets server-side and use `.env.example` for required variables.
- Run `npm.cmd run build` after route or component changes.
